# `WorldApi::get_overlay_mode`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-engine-side">engine-side</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **World API** (`src/plugins/api/world_api.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Returns the active overlay mode when the caller supplied overlay context.

## Signature

```rust
fn get_overlay_mode (& self) -> Option < OverlayMode >
```

## Arguments

This method does not take plugin-supplied arguments.

## Return Value

Option < [`OverlayMode`](../enums/overlaymode.md) >

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/worldapi-get-overlay-mode.md`](../../examples/methods/worldapi-get-overlay-mode.md)_

```rust
if let Some(mode) = world.get_overlay_mode() {
    if mode.is_gas() {
        println!("gas overlay is active");
    }
}
```
